payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over circle to compute base bullets needed if each monster relies on previous explosion; then add the minimum extra cost to start the chain from the optimal monster, found by min(a_i, b_{i-1}).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange argument: any optimal killing sequence can be shifted to start with the monster that minimizes the additional bullets needed to initiate the chain, as the rest follow deterministically.
